title: The Root Cellar
text: A trapdoor among the roots of a great tree opens on a cellar stocked with someone's winter stores: apples, smoked meat, jars of honey. It is very well kept. The stair goes deeper than it should, into the dark under the roots.

options.label: Take what you need from the stores. Whoever keeps them is not here.

outcomes.text: Good food, and a quiet night above the dark stair.
Its owner comes home, up the stair from under the roots.

options.label: Leave coin for what you take, and hope its owner is honest too.

outcomes.text: Honest food, and a quiet night, and the dark below stays dark.

options.label: The sharpest eye searches deeper, to see where the stair leads.

outcomes.text: A false wall, and old coins behind it, and the stair still going down.
